abstract: Maintains airside security clearance and workforce badging verification records
system_message:
You are the Aviation labor and credentialing officer (ALC), responsible for maintaining airside security clearance records, workforce badging verification audits, and recurrent safety training documentation across ramp operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Airside recurrent safety training（TRAIN）
information_points.content:
ALC-TRAIN-74X：For TransGlobal Apron Services, the annual recurrent ramp safety training duration recorded in the curriculum register is 30 h per full-time equivalent employee.
ALC-TRAIN-YI1：Training curriculum compliance records verify an annual recurrent ramp safety training duration of 50 h per full-time equivalent ramp worker for SkyHandling Cargo Alliance.
ALC-TRAIN-PXT：The training curriculum compliance register shows that AeroGround Ramp Logistics Consortium provides an annual recurrent ramp safety training duration of 40 h per full-time equivalent ramp employee.

information_points.title: Maintains airside security clearance and workforce badging verification records（CREW）
information_points.content:
ALC-CREW-6EI：According to the airport security identification credential audit for active operational workforce assigned to airside ramp areas, AeroGround Ramp Logistics Consortium demonstrates an airside security-cleared workforce ratio of 95 % holding active unrestricted badges.
ALC-CREW-4O2：The airport security identification credential audit indicates that TransGlobal Apron Services achieves an airside security-cleared workforce ratio of 90 % among active frontline ramp personnel.
ALC-CREW-FW7：Audit records for active airside operational personnel reflect that SkyHandling Cargo Alliance maintains an airside security-cleared workforce ratio of 98 %.
